entities.name: Zoe
entities.description: A Euphorean dryad, nymph of Nylea on Theros, born from the sadness of Polukranos's death, who journeys to understand other Euphoreans and humans.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: Zoe's master, god of the forest.

entities.name: Polukranos
entities.description: A legendary hydra whose loss saddens Zoe at her creation.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: Master of the fiery oread nymphs.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: Master of the alseid nymph Zoe meets.

entities.name: Oreads
entities.description: Two fiery Euphorean nymphs serving Purphoros who consume a murderer.

entities.name: Alseid
entities.description: Nymph protecting her meadow's sheep from humans.

entities.name: Naiad
entities.description: Water nymph who warns Zoe of the dangers of the water.

entities.name: Lampad
entities.description: A sad dark nymph living in a cave, waiting for death, who takes the drowned hunter.

entities.name: Nylea's forest
entities.description: Zoe's home forest and olive grove.

events.summary: Upon her creation Zoe feels the sadness of Polukranos's loss; Nylea tells her it will shape her course and bids her dance with her sisters.
events.quote: she was born from the sadness of a dying legend

events.summary: Zoe witnesses a hunter killed by an arrow, and two fiery oreads consume the murderer.
events.quote: two fiery oreads appeared and consumed her instantaneously.

events.summary: Zoe bids the oreads leave and, inspired, decides to learn from other Euphoreans.
events.quote: The encounter inspired Zoe, who wished to know more about other types of Euphoreans.

events.summary: Zoe meets an alseid of Heliod who explains how human warriors massacre her flocks.
events.quote: It seemed to Zoe that all of nature was harmed by humans.

events.summary: Zoe meets a naiad at a lake who warns of ships killing and stealing from the water.
events.quote: yet far worse are ships floating on the waves, killing and stealing from the water.

events.summary: Zoe finds a dark lampad in a cave, who says she is waiting for death.
events.quote: the nymph said that she was waiting for death.

events.summary: Zoe charms a hunter aiming at a sleeping wolf into drowning in a stream; the lampad takes the body into her cave.
events.quote: He fell into the stream and stayed there, drowning.

events.summary: Zoe returns to her olive grove and sings her sisters the song of her journey.
events.quote: A morning later, Zoe was back in her olive grove.
